scope: Offline implementation review, not human or historical grading

findings.finding: Self-asserted R1–R4 clearance could authorize a blocked real launch
findings.action: Real entry requires independently pinned T55 clearance. Trusted identity deliberately absent; caller registry assertions refuse before transport. Regression added.

findings.finding: Incomplete provider JSON could produce valid-looking host export
findings.action: All non-completed provider statuses use versioned transport-failure export with exact entity bytes; regression added.

findings.finding: HTTP framing surplus and cancellation/late-POST race
findings.action: Reject surplus framed bytes and serialize cancelled-state/send; fake delayed-worker regression

findings.finding: Invalid UTF-8 response could lose exact bytes or imply empty model reply
findings.action: Strict decoding; exact entity base64 and raw HTTP digest retained in distinct failure export; model reply identity absent

findings.finding: Boolean input usage or zero output could appear valid
findings.action: Require actual int exact input and positive capped output; unknown usage remains unknown

findings.finding: Synthetic fixtures are not authentic native preprocessing or executable security evidence
findings.action: Explicit simulation profile/test hook, tiny marker blobs; operator inspects fixture executable. No sandbox or genuine native fit claim. Real trusted clearance absent.
